text:
Alex H: good morning team — quick handoff from my shift, primary -> Mira, secondary -> Jordan. i'm on the commute but leaving notes here.

Alex H: Active pages: none open right now. last night we had a KV cache latency blip (pager fired at 02:12 UTC) but it auto-recovered after a cache flush and a restart of the inference-router pod.

incident-bot: Pager acknowledged: KV_CACHE_HIGH_LATENCY (severity: P2) — acknowledged by Alex H at 1766119200

Alex H: Key things to watch in the next 4 hours:
- bursts in inference-router p95 > 400ms
- errors spike on model-serving (5xx) correlated with cache misses
- quota alerts for dedicated clusters (billing/thresholds)

Alex H: Runbooks/quick links:
- KV cache fallback runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/98432/KV+cache+fallback
- Inference router restart play: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/10211/Inference+Router+Restart
- Canary rollback checklist: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/11000/Canary+Rollback+Checklist

Mira P: thanks Alex — taking primary. quick q: any ongoing customer-impacting requests?

Alex H: no active customer tickets tied to last night. Post-incident notes sent to #incidents. If you see a sustained p95 > 500ms, follow KV cache runbook and escalate to infra oncall.

Jordan K: noted. for the runbook, the first two steps are:
1) check cache hit ratio dashboard (Console > Observability > Caching)
2) if hit ratio < 60% start prefix eviction job (playbook command below)

Jordan K: command we used last night:
```bash
kubectl -n inference exec deploy/cache-maint -- /scripts/evict_prefixes.sh --age 3600 --dry-run=false
```

Sam C: adding a quick check for routing overload: run
```bash
kubectl get hpa -n inference inference-router -o yaml | grep -E "currentReplicas|desiredReplicas"
```
if desiredReplicas is ramping to max for >5m, route to backup region per routing policy.

Mira P: i'm going to run through the dashboard checklist now. tagging @Jordan K — if you see any 5xxs spike, please run the health-check probe and paste results here.

Jordan K: will do. health probe:
```bash
curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null "https://inference-router.prod.redwood/api/healthz"
```
expected: 200, body: {"ok":true, "cache": "ok"}

incident-bot: New pager triggered: DEDICATED_CLUSTER_QUOTA (severity: P3) — auto-notify sent to finance-alerts

Alex H: FYI on coverage gaps: there's no on-call engineer in APAC overnight tonight (we've had trouble with rotations). if something degrades in ap-southeast we might need to wake infra oncall.

Mira P: noted. i'll set a watch on region routing and increase sampling for the first hour of my shift.

Sam C: small reminder — if you need to evict the KV prefix, update the audit ticket with the command output and attach the logs from /var/log/cache-maint. ops policy requires the logfile snippet.

Mira P: thanks. checklist i'm following:
- verify cache hit ratio
- run health probe
- if failure, run eviction script (Jordan cmd) and restart inference-router pod with graceful drain
- post actions: file incident note, attach logs, notify customer success if SLA impacted

Jordan K: quick note on safe rollback: if you need to rollback canary model, use the console rollback button + add tag `rollback:hotfix-<ts>` in the release notes. avoid manual model redeploy unless console fails.

Mira P: copying runbook snippets I'm using into the handoff ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-4123

Alex H: dexter tip — if you see repeated cache misses with increasing tail latency, consider toggling `cache_prefetch` to false in runtime config as short-term mitigation (only for high-traffic routes). config path: `configs/runtime/inference-router.yaml`

Sam C: putting a short set of CLI quick commands for the handoff in case Mira needs them fast:
- check pods: `kubectl get pods -n inference | grep inference-router`
- tail logs: `kubectl logs -n inference deploy/inference-router -f --tail=200`
- restart pod (graceful): `kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-router -n inference`

Mira P: appreciated. i'm on primary now, will update when i run the checks (back in ~10m).

Alex H: thanks — i'm reachable if you need context. leaving the bridge open for 30m. :thumbsup:

Mira P: all checks done: cache hit ratio at 78%, health probe OK, no 5xx spikes. marking handoff live. i'll re-run checks every 30m for the first 2 hours.

Jordan K: copy — i'll stay on standby for any cache eviction commands.

incident-bot: Reminder: weekly oncall rota published https://redwood.internal/schedule (next rotation in 6 days)

Mira P: closing the thread for now, leaving a short note on the ticket. if something pops, i'll re-open here. :white_check_mark:
